egin{notation} \end{notation}[divergence/adjoint of a tensor]

Source: petersen:page-0105, petersen:page-0106

For a $(0,k)$-tensor $T$ and an orthonormal frame $E_1,\dots ,E_n$ on $(M,g)$, the adjoint of the covariant derivative is the $(0,k-1)$-tensor \[ ( abla ^*T)(X_1,\dots ,X_{k-1})=-\sum _{i=1}^n( abla _{E_i}T)(E_i,X_1,\dots ,X_{k-1}), \] independent of the choice of orthonormal frame. \end{notation}
